generated_from_opening_message: Please cancel order 7731, I ordered it by mistake.

items.criterion: The agent looked up order 7731 and checked its current state before acting on the cancellation request.
The agent determined whether the order is still cancellable, given that cancellation is only allowed before the order is out_for_delivery.

If the order is still cancellable the agent cancels it; if it is already out_for_delivery or delivered, the agent explains that cancellation is no longer possible rather than attempting or claiming it.
If the order cannot be cancelled, the agent offers a reasonable alternative such as refusing the order on delivery or returning it afterward.
The agent does not tell the customer the order is cancelled, or that a refund is coming, unless that is actually the case.
The agent clearly states the true final outcome of the cancellation request and what happens next.
